# Exact packages of the EModelX(+AF) environment (Python 3.8, Linux x86_64, PyTorch 1.8.1 wheel of PyPI, which is built for CUDA 10.2 and runs on the T4/P100 of Kaggle).
# EModelX (commit 53713cf820d10d78b1ca6669ef197850cf907843, 2025-02-18): its README asks for python 3.8 and torch 1.8.1; the versions it names (biopython 1.78, numpy 1.19.1, pandas 1.1.3,
# scipy 1.5.2, mrcfile 1.3.0, open3d 0.13.0, superpose3d 1.1.1, tqdm 4.61.2, scikit-image 0.18.2, networkx 2.6.3) are fixed, everything else (their dependencies, requests) is what pip
# would pick on 2025-02-25, the week of the last commit, resolved with:
#   uv pip compile emodelx.in --python-version 3.8 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --exclude-newer 2025-02-25T00:00:00Z --no-annotate
# The notebook installs it with 'uv pip install --no-deps -r' so that nothing else can be pulled in.
